description: Fired when request triage cost and tier classification is completed by dss_optimizer_v2.
Fired when memory loading and requirement analyst checks have populated the design space.
Fired when the architect has completed system design plans.
Fired when the design debate completes with weighted consensus score >= 80%.
Fired when design author incorporates debate corrections into final design blueprint.
Fired when design revision reveals architectural gaps requiring redesign.
Fired when the response aggregator compiles specification and critiques into tasks.
Fired when dss_builder_v2 completes coding tasks sequentially.
Fired when per-task verification passes on isolated builder sandbox.
Fired when per-task verification fails on isolated builder sandbox.
Fired when verified task sandbox is merged cleanly into primary branch.
Fired when integration checks on DTOs, endpoint URLs, and migrations are healthy.
Fired when pytest/Playwright test suites execute without errors.
Fired when a test failure, logic flaw, or parameter sanity check fails.
Fired when recovery analysis compiles a Failure Report and maps a fix loop.
Fired when user validation passes and build is ready for release audits.
Fired when the release manager confirms final build safety.
Fired when continuous monitoring confirms stable post-release deployment.
Fired when telemetry or log monitoring detects a production anomaly.
Fired when production feedback is analyzed to isolate root cause.
Fired when an issue requires an emergency hotfix loop.
Fired when user cancels or modifies objectives, resetting FSM to triage.
Fired when design debate fails to reach consensus score.
Fired when requirements have omissions or ambiguities requiring user feedback.
Fired when the user responds to clarifying questions and design begins.
